sections.featuresTitle: Bipụta nke ọma. Wuo ntụkwasụ obi. Rahụ ụra nke ọma.
sections.featuresSub: Ngwá ọrụ isii na-agbanwe ọgba aghara ụtụ Naijiria n'ụzọ doro anya — na ndekọ ndị na-agbazite ego na-atụkwasụ.
sections.f1Title: Mara ihe ị kwesiri ị kwụ
sections.f1Body: Ụtụ ego, VAT, WHT, a na-agbakọ ha n'otu ntabi anya — n'ime ₦, site n'isi ihe ndị ị nwere ike ịtụkwasụ.
sections.f2Body: Azịza nwere ebe ọmụma n'iwu ụtụ Naijiria — VAT, PAYE, WHT, TIN — na-enweghị okwu siri ike.
sections.f3Title: Wuo ntụkwasụ obi ndị na-agbazite ego
sections.f3Body: Akụkọ ibipụta gị ghọrọ ọkwa ndị ụlọ akụ na-aghọta — ndekọ ka mma, gbazite dị mfe.
sections.f4Body: Debe ọgwụgwụ oge, kwadebe akwụkwọ ọghọm, ma chụso Akwụkwọ Nkwenye ụtụ gị n'oge.
sections.f5Body: Tinye nnata na akwụkwọ ịgbazinye ego — anyị na-ewepụta ọnụ ọgụgụ na-edebe ha dị mma maka ibipụta.
sections.f6Title: Ndị ọkachamara ụtụ a kwenyere nso gị
sections.f6Body: Chọta ndị ọkachamara CAC a kwenyere mgbe ibipụta si ike — map, ọkwa, kpọtụrụ ọha.
sections.howTitle: Njegharị atọ ruo na ndekọ ụtụ ndị na-agbazite ego na-atụkwasụ
sections.how1Body: Kọwa ọnọdụ gị n'asụsụ dị mfe ma ọ bụ tinye akwụkwọ.
sections.how2Body: Ọnụ ọgụgụ dị mma maka ibipụta na azịza dabere n'iwu ụtụ Naijiria.
sections.how3Body: Gbanwe ndekọ nrube isi gị ghọọ profaịlụ ntụkwasụ obi ndị na-agbazite ego na-aghọta.
sections.pubsSub: Ihe ndị ode akwụkwọ na ndị partner na-ekwu gbasara ikpo okwu ụtụ & ntụkwasụ obi e wuru maka Naijiria.
sections.stake1Title: Gwa m ihe m kwesiri ị kwụ. Nyere m aka ibipụta. Me ka ndị na-agbazite tụkwasụ m.
sections.stake1Body: Otu dashboard maka ahụike ụtụ gị, ibipụta na ntụkwasụ obi — n'asụsụ ị na-eche echiche.
sections.stake2Title: Ndị ahịa a kwenyere. Ọtụtụ ọtụtụ. Akwụkwọ ole na ole.
sections.stake2Body: Sonye ahịa, kwenyere njirimara na ọkụ, ma gba ao ọtụtụ ndị ahịa n'ọtụtụ.
sections.stake3Title: Ihe ndabere ụtụ Naijirịa dị irè na ị nwere ike iwu
sections.stake3Body: API dị ọcha maka ụtụ, ntụkwasụ obi na akwụkwọ na nchebe otu nrube isi gị na-ele.
sections.marketTitle: Chọta onye ọkachamara ụtụ a kwenyere nso gị
sections.marketSub: Ndị ọkachamara CAC enyochala na ọkwa na kpọtụrụ ọha.
sections.pricingTitle: Malite n'efu. Kwụọ mgbe ị na-ebipụta.
sections.pricingSub: Ihe nturụ mkpokọta na azịza dị n'efu ruo mgbe ebighị ebi. Ibipụta na akụkọ na-akwụ ụgwọ mgbe eji.
sections.newsTitle: Oge ụtụ, n'ụzọ doro anya na n'oge
sections.newsSub: Email kwa ọnwa: gbanwere iwu ụtụ Naijiria, ihe ọ pụtara maka ego gị.
sections.newsSuccess: E debanyela aha gị — ozi ọzọ ga-abata na igbe ozi gị.
sections.newsError: Tinye email ziri ezi iji debanye aha.
sections.stake4Title: Igbipụta ọ bụla n'oge na-akwụlite ọkwa gị.
sections.stake4Body: Hụ otu akụkọ ụtụ, ịdị ogologo akwụkwọ na ụdị ịkwụ ụgwọ jikọtara ike ọmụma ntụkwasụ obi ndị na-agbazite ego na Naijiria na-amata.
sections.stake4Cta: Hụ otu ntụkwasụ obi si arụ ọrụ
sections.stake5Title: Nnata abanye. Ọnụ ọgụgụ apụta. Dị mma maka ibipụta.
sections.stake5Body: Tinye foto nnata na akwụkwọ ịgbazinye ego — anyị na-ewepụta ọnụ ọgụgụ, kekọrịta mmefu ego, na-edebe ihe niile dị mma maka ibipụta gị ọzọ.
sections.stake6Title: Ụgwọ ọrụ, VAT na igbipụta — na-enweghị ọgba aghara spreadsheet.
sections.stake6Body: Gba ọrụ PAYE, debe VAT n’ime otu quarters, na-edebe akwụkwọ nrube isi dị mma maka nyocha maka otu ndị otu gị niile.

waitlist.title: Sonye ndepụta
waitlist.desc: Nweta ohere mbupu ga-emeghe n'ụmụ. Tinye email gị, anyị ga-agwa gị ozugbo Creditax apụta.
waitlist.success: Ị nọ na ndepụta. Anyị ga-ezitere gị ozi email mgbe Creditax pụtara.
waitlist.successDuplicate: Email a nọọla na ndepụta — ọ dịghị ihe ọzọ a ga-eme.
waitlist.successDesc: Ọ dịghị spam. Otu email mmepụta, ma n'ikpeazụ naanị ihe ị họrọ.
waitlist.error: Ihe mebiri n'akụkụ anyị. Anyị na-edozi — nwaa ọzọ n' obere oge.
waitlist.note: Otu email mgbe ọ pụtara. Wepụ aha mgbe ọ bụla.
